text:
```yaml
name: Check Dist

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'dist/**'

jobs:
  check-dist:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Fail if dist/ is modified
        run: |
          echo "❌ dist/ directory was modified in this pull request."
          echo "This workflow prevents untrusted dist changes from being merged."
          exit 1
```
